lines.en: label chapthree7:
The cover of a thousand trees will not protect you from the light of the sun if the sun is determined to find you.
lines.zh: 如果太阳铁了心要找到你,一千棵树的遮蔽也保护不了你免受阳光。

lines.en: No amount of leaves or branches or wildlife willing to soak up the rays in your stead can successfully combat the stubbornness of a fiery god with an anger untamed.
lines.zh: 再多的叶子、再多的树枝、再多愿意替你吸收那些光线的野生动物,也敌不过一位怒火未驯的火之神的固执。

lines.en: But what reason is there to be angry when you have everything you’ve ever wanted?
lines.zh: 可当你已经拥有了自己想要的一切,又有什么理由愤怒?

lines.en: What is the purpose of looking down on someone who doesn’t?
lines.zh: 去俯视一个什么都没有的人,又有什么意义?

lines.en: What is the cause for concern here?
lines.zh: 这里有什么值得担忧的?

lines.en: The sun will always find you.
lines.zh: 太阳总会找到你。

lines.en: It will always chase you.
lines.zh: 它总会追逐你。

lines.en: And even if you’re able to find somewhere slightly out of its reach, it does not mean you’re out of its {i}sight.{/i}
lines.zh: 而哪怕你能找到一个略微超出它触及范围的地方,也不代表你逃出了它的{i}视线。{/i}

lines.en: scene rinmolly1
Open your eyes and tell me what you see.
lines.zh: 睁开眼睛,告诉我你看见了什么。

lines.en: Is it something completely devoid of a stubborn, fiery god?
lines.zh: 那是个完全没有那个固执的火之神的东西吗?

lines.en: Or is it a park bench, just beyond the reach of the light?
lines.zh: 还是一张公园长椅,刚好在光照之外?

lines.en: One that, even if it {i}weren’t{/i} carefully positioned twenty feet away from a tree older than everyone alive right now, would have its own form of shade.
lines.zh: 一张哪怕没有{i}被{/i}精心安放在离一棵比现在所有活着的人都更老的树二十英尺远的地方,也会拥有自己一片阴凉的长椅。

lines.en: One that, several seasons ago, would be warm to the touch and not chilled by the weight of a slowly detaching pair of misfits as everything about them grows colder day by day.
lines.zh: 一张在几个季节之前摸上去会是温暖的、而不会被一对正慢慢分离的、不合时宜的人的重量压得冰凉的长椅——随着他们的一切一天天变冷。

lines.en: One that you wish you could see firsthand- from behind the corner of a school building, soaked in whatever it is that shades {i}you{/i} in your perpetual race from the light.
lines.zh: 一张你希望能亲眼看见的长椅——从学校建筑的转角后面,浸在那些在你永不停歇地逃离光线的过程中为{i}你{/i}遮阳的东西里。

lines.en: scene rinmolly2
YOU CAN NOT RUN FROM IT
lines.zh: 你无法逃离它

lines.en: YOU CAN NOT HIDE
lines.zh: 你无法躲藏

lines.en: YOUR RESISTANCE WILL ONLY MAKE THINGS HARDER FOR THE ONES THAT YOU LOVE
lines.zh: 你的抗拒,只会让你所爱的那些人更加艰难

lines.en: THE FURTHER YOU STRAY, THE CLOSER THE THREADS COME TO TEARING
lines.zh: 你走得越远,那些丝线就越接近断裂

lines.en: SPREAD THIN LIKE THE LIMBS OF A DYING CAT, IT ALL BECOMES WEAKER
lines.zh: 像垂死之猫的四肢那样摊得稀薄,一切都变得更脆弱

lines.en: scene rinmolly1
Until-
lines.zh: 直到——

lines.en: Eventually-
lines.zh: 最终——

lines.en: The only thing left of the thread is the memory of the weaver who weaved it.
lines.zh: 丝线剩下的唯一东西,是织它的那位织工留下的记忆。

lines.en: The only thing left of the weaver is the memory of the thread she would weave.
lines.zh: 织工剩下的唯一东西,是她本会织出的那根丝线的记忆。

lines.en: You, too-
lines.zh: 你也一样——

lines.en: Will burn in the light one day.
lines.zh: 总有一天会在光里燃烧。

lines.en: But for now-
lines.zh: 但至少现在——

lines.en: Take solace in the fact that you still have the energy to run.
lines.zh: 你还有力气奔跑,就从这一点里寻些安慰吧。

lines.en: : So, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……

lines.en: : Summer...right?
lines.zh: : 夏天……对吧?

lines.en: scene rinmolly3
: Hah...
: Okay, listen.
lines.zh: : 好吧,听我说。

lines.en: scene rinmolly4
: I know what it’s like to want something or...{i}someone{/i} you can’t have.
lines.zh: : 我知道想要某样东西、或者……某个{i}人{/i},却得不到的感觉。

lines.en: : And I know that...being so close to whatever that thing or...person is can...make you do things you’re not proud of.
lines.zh: : 我也知道……当你离那样东西、或者那个人太近的时候,会……让你做出一些自己并不自豪的事。

lines.en: : I do tons of shit I’m not proud of all the time. That’s basically like, half of what I’ve done ever since I was born.
lines.zh: : 我他妈一天到晚都在做一堆自己不自豪的事。那基本就是我出生以来所做的事的一半。

lines.en: : I got burned {i}hard{/i} when I confessed to Chika. Hard enough that, even today...even when I have someone I’m genuinely happy with...
lines.zh: : 我向 Chika 表白的时候,被烧得{i}很惨{/i}。惨到即便到了今天……即便我现在已经有了真心让我幸福的人……

lines.en: : It {i}still{/i} hurts when I look at her.
lines.zh: : 看着她的时候,我{i}还是{/i}会疼。

lines.en: : So...if you’re anything like me...which I know for a fact you are...
lines.zh: : 所以……如果你跟我有一点像的话……而我敢肯定你就是……

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s the same.
lines.zh: : 我相信你也是一样的。

lines.en: : And that sucks...that sucks a lot...
lines.zh: : 而这糟透了……真的糟透了……

lines.en: : And if you would have asked me what I would do if I were in Chika’s position back then, I’m sure my answer would have been a lot different than...what actually happened once I {i}was.{/i} You know?
lines.zh: : 而且如果当时你问我,要是站在 Chika 的位置上我会怎么做,我敢肯定我的答案,会和我真的{i}站上去{/i}之后实际做出的事,差得很远。你知道吗?

lines.en: : It’s...hard.
lines.zh: : 这……很难。

lines.en: : It’s awkward..
lines.zh: : 很尴尬……

lines.en: : It’s-
scene rinmolly5
: It’s my fault. I {i}know{/i} it’s my fault. I just...I’m really bad at holding myself back when-
lines.zh: : 是我的错。我{i}知道{/i}是我的错。我只是……我真的很不会克制自己,当——

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to be {i}anyone’s{/i} fault, Molly.
lines.zh: : 这不必是{i}任何人{/i}的错,Molly。

lines.en: : How am I, the queen of shitty impulsive decisions, going to forever hold the shitty impulsive decision of {i}someone else{/i} against them?
lines.zh: : 我这个「糟糕冲动决定女王」,又怎么能永远拿{i}别人{/i}一个糟糕的冲动决定去记恨人家?

lines.en: scene rinmolly6
: Wait...you’re not...saying you forgive me, are you?...
lines.zh: : 等等……你不是……在说你原谅我了吧?……

lines.en: : Is that what you wanted to talk about? You...you wanted to tell me that we can move past this? That we can go back to being friends?
lines.zh: : 这就是你想谈的事?你……你想告诉我,我们可以翻篇了?我们可以重新做回朋友?

lines.en: : Because I can do it, you know? I can hold back. I can-
lines.zh: : 因为我做得到的,你知道吗?我能克制。我能——

lines.en: : That’s not what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是这个。

lines.en: scene rinmolly7
: In fact, that’s kind of the opposite of what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 事实上,这跟我说的差不多正好相反。

lines.en: : But...But you-
lines.zh: : 可是……可是你——

lines.en: : You still...you know...{i}like{/i} me...don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还是……你知道的……{i}喜欢{/i}我……对吧?

lines.en: scene rinmolly8
: Well, I...I can’t just {i}stop.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯,我……我没法就这么{i}停下来{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ve liked you...pretty much ever since we met...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你……差不多从我们认识起就开始了……

lines.en: : I always thought you were like a...cooler...less awkward and...more Japanese version of me...
lines.zh: : 我一直觉得你就像是一个……更酷的……不那么别扭的、而且……更像日本人的我……

lines.en: : Me? {i}Less{/i} awkward? That’s new.
lines.zh: : 我?{i}不{/i}别扭?这倒是新鲜。

lines.en: : I saw myself in you. But it was like...a better version of myself. One that actually figured out a way to fit in with people outside of my bubble.
lines.zh: : 我在你身上看见了我自己。但又像是……一个更好的版本的我自己。一个真的找到了办法,能跟我那个小圈子以外的人打成一片的自己。

lines.en: : One that {i}wanted{/i} to fit in outside of my bubble...
lines.zh: : 一个{i}想要{/i}融入我那个小圈子之外的人……

lines.en: : Someone who could look at someone {i}so{/i} different from them and still manage to see so much good that it would...transcend feelings of friendship and evolve into something greater.
lines.zh: : 一个能看着一个跟自己{i}如此{/i}不同的人,却依然能看见那么多美好的东西,多到……超越了友情,进化成了某种更伟大的东西。

lines.en: : Coming to understand that should have been the nail in the coffin.
lines.zh: : 想明白这一点,本该是钉进棺材的最后一颗钉子。

lines.en: : Coming to understand that should have been the thing that made me think, “Molly...just give up.”
lines.zh: : 想明白这一点,本该是让我想通的那件事——「Molly……放弃吧。」

lines.en: scene rinmolly9
: Molly...you’ll never be the type of girl she wants.
lines.zh: : Molly……你永远不可能是她想要的那种女孩。

lines.en: : Molly...you’ll never be anything more than an awkward, unattractive loser who lives in her own world!
lines.zh: : Molly……你永远都只能是个别扭又没魅力、活在自己世界里的失败者!

lines.en: : You’ll never be anything more than that! Of course the better version of you would see it! Of course she would-
lines.zh: : 你永远都只能是这样!当然那个更好的版本的你会看得出来!她当然会——

lines.en: : Molly, stop. Come on.
lines.zh: : Molly,别说了。行了。

lines.en: scene rinmolly10
: Do you think I don’t want to?!
lines.zh: : 你以为我不想吗?!

lines.en: : Do you think I wanted to lose my best friend?! That I wanted to...{i}force{/i} my feelings on her?! That I wanted to disregard the things I {i}knew{/i} because I was too afraid to believe them?!
lines.zh: : 你以为我想失去我最好的朋友吗?!你以为我想……把我的感情{i}强加{/i}给她吗?!你以为我想因为我太害怕不敢相信,就无视我{i}明明知道{/i}的那些事吗?!

lines.en: : Of course not...
lines.zh: : 当然不想……

lines.en: : Then-
: But you {i}did.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可你{i}确实做了{/i}。

lines.en: scene rinmolly11
: You {i}did{/i} do all of those things despite knowing how I felt. {i}That’s{/i} what I’m more upset about than anything else.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确实{/i}做了所有这些事,尽管你知道我的感受。而{i}这才是{/i}我比什么都更生气的地方。

lines.en: : I can look past the shitty impulsive decisions like that kiss on Christmas and...and I can even look past the whole tackling thing.
lines.zh: : 那些糟糕的冲动决定,像圣诞节那个吻,我可以既往不咎……甚至连扑倒那件事我也可以不计较。

lines.en: : But, no matter how hard I try, the one thing I {i}can’t{/i} look past is how you straight up ignored my feelings because you didn’t want to accept them.
lines.zh: : 但不管我怎么努力,我{i}唯一{/i}没法释怀的,是你就这么直接无视了我的感受,只因为你不愿意接受它们。

lines.en: scene rinmolly12
: But you didn’t even {i}understand{/i} mine! That’s even worse!
lines.zh: : 可你根本连我的感受都没{i}理解{/i}过!那更糟!

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: scene rinmolly13
: Maybe?...
lines.zh: : 也许是?……

lines.en: : I don’t even know anymore...
lines.zh: : 我已经不知道了……

lines.en: : If you think what I did is worse, fine. That’s something we’ll just have to disagree on.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得我做的更糟,那好吧。这一点我们只能各执己见了。

lines.en: : But if I fully understood how you felt and that what I was doing was going to hurt you, I never would have done it.
lines.zh: : 但如果我完全明白你的感受,也明白我正在做的事会伤害你,我绝不会去做。

lines.en: : You see yourself in me, don’t you? You see a girl who gets excited about the smallest things and can’t hold back her excitement when a huge, life-changing opportunity presents itself.
lines.zh: : 你在我身上看见了你自己,对吧?你看见一个会因为最小的事情就兴奋不已、当一个巨大的、改变人生的机会出现时根本按捺不住的女孩。

lines.en: : I see a girl who doesn’t get opportunities like that.
lines.zh: : 而我看见的,是一个从来得不到那种机会的女孩。

lines.en: : Of course I would be jealous when the one I’ve been admiring this whole time does.
lines.zh: : 当然,当那个我一直仰慕着的人得到了机会,我会嫉妒。

lines.en: : Are you happy for me, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你为我高兴吗,Molly?

lines.en: scene rinmolly14
: What?...
: Are you happy for me now that I finally have someone who likes me the same way I like them?
lines.zh: : 我终于有了一个跟我喜欢他一样喜欢我的人,你为我高兴吗?

lines.en: : Of...Of course...
: And you really mean that? You’re not just saying it because that’s what I want to hear?
lines.zh: : 你真这么想?不只是因为这是我想听的话才这么说?

lines.en: : Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: : Just be honest. I’m not going to get mad.
lines.zh: : 说实话就好。我不会生气的。

lines.en: scene rinmolly15
: I really am happy for you...
lines.zh: : 我真的为你高兴……

lines.en: : And I’m even happier that the girl you like is so great and...good for you.
lines.zh: : 而且我更高兴的是,你喜欢的那个女孩那么好、那么……配得上你。

lines.en: : But what I’m most happy about is that you don’t have to feel the way I feel right now.
lines.zh: : 但我最高兴的是,你不必去感受我此刻正在感受的这种感觉。

lines.en: scene rinmolly16
: You know, after Chika rejected me...someone else who was equally as important at the time told me, “There are plenty of things in life that are going to hurt just as bad as this.”
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,在 Chika 拒绝我之后……另一个在当时同样重要的人跟我说过:「人生里还有很多事,会跟这件事一样疼。」

lines.en: : And while that person isn’t really known for their amazing life advice, I think those words are exactly what you need right now.
lines.zh: : 虽然那个人并不以给出绝妙人生建议而闻名,但我觉得那句话正是你现在需要听的。

lines.en: scene rinmolly17
: Just look at me. I had to fall on my ass harder than ever before I wound up with somebody I wanted to be with.
lines.zh: : 看看我就知道了。我得摔得比以往都狠,才最终遇上了想在一起的人。

lines.en: : You might be hurting right now, and it might feel like the whole world is crashing down around you...
lines.zh: : 你现在也许很疼,也许觉得整个世界都在朝你坍塌……

lines.en: : But one day, you’re going to find someone else you can see yourself in. And when that happens, this will all feel like just a blip on the radar.
lines.zh: : 但总有一天,你会找到另一个能在对方身上看见自己的人。到那时,这一切都会感觉只是雷达上的一个小点而已。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : That person won’t be you...
lines.zh: : 那个人不会是你……

lines.en: scene rinmolly18

lines.zh: : 不会……

lines.en: : That person won’t be me.
lines.zh: : 那个人不会是我。

lines.en: : I’m glad you wanted it to be, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴,你曾经希望那会是我。

lines.en: : Only two people have ever liked me.
lines.zh: : 喜欢过我的人,一共只有两个。

lines.en: : Three counting Sensei. He likes you too.
lines.zh: : 算上 Sensei 是三个。他也喜欢你。

lines.en: : Sensei likes everybody. He doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : Sensei 喜欢每一个人。他不算。

lines.en: : What a life it must be...waking up as the protagonist of an H-game every morning...
lines.zh: : 那该是什么样的生活啊……每天早上醒来,都是一款 H-game 的主角……

lines.en: : What a life indeed...
lines.zh: : 是啊,该是什么样的生活……

lines.en: scene rinmolly19
: Well, umm...anyway...does...
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……总之……是不是……

lines.en: : Does this mean we don’t have to avoid each other anymore?
lines.zh: : 是不是意味着我们不用再互相躲着了?

lines.en: : I can’t promise that my feelings for you will just vanish, but...I think the fact that you actually wanted to talk about this means that things...
lines.zh: : 我不能保证我对你的感情会就这么消失,不过……我觉得,你真的愿意来谈这件事,本身就说明事情……

lines.en: : Things can go back to normal?...
lines.zh: : 事情可以回到正常了?……

lines.en: : Molly...
lines.zh: : Molly……

lines.en: : I don’t know if there will ever be a “normal” for us after this.
lines.zh: : 我不知道在这之后,我们之间还会不会有所谓的「正常」。

lines.en: : And if there ever is, I don’t think that just one talk will be enough to get us there.
lines.zh: : 就算有,我也不觉得光靠这一场谈话就够让我们走到那儿。

lines.en: : I still think it would be good for us to sort of...distance ourselves and...focus more on people we {i}don’t{/i} really relate to the way we do.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得,我们也许该稍微……保持点距离,然后……把注意力多放在那些我们并{i}不{/i}那么容易产生共鸣的人身上。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : I’m not mad anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不再生气了。

lines.en: : Well, technically, I {i}am{/i} still a little bit mad. But that’s mostly because you both stole my first kiss and then proceeded to almost steal my virginity at the beach.
lines.zh: : 呃,严格来说,我{i}确实{/i}还有点生气。不过那主要是因为你们俩偷走了我的初吻,接着又在海滩上差点把我的童贞也顺走。

lines.en: scene rinmolly20
: Th-That wasn’t-
lines.zh: : 那……那不是——

lines.en: : Relax...it was just a joke.
lines.zh: : 放松……只是开个玩笑。

lines.en: scene rinmolly21
: Oh...S...Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦……对……对不起。

lines.en: : Either way, I still think a little distance would be best for us right now. But it’s not like I’m going to avoid you or anything since we still have a lot of the same friends.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样,我还是觉得现在我们稍微保持点距离比较好。但我也不会真的躲着你什么的,毕竟我们还有很多共同的朋友。

lines.en: : Just...don’t expect any late night eroge marathons anytime soon.
lines.zh: : 只是……别指望短期内还能有深夜 eroge 马拉松了。

lines.en: scene rinmolly22
: That’s fine. I’ve had my fill of them for the meantime anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正这段时间我也已经看够了。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, I see that you and I handle our sadness a little bit differently.
lines.zh: : 哦。看来你和我处理悲伤的方式还真不太一样。

lines.en: : And I’m sure you’ll hear much more about just that at our next club meeting...
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定,下次社团活动的时候,你会听到更多关于这件事的话……

lines.en: scene rinmolly23
: Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: : That was kind of the...big thing I wanted to talk about today.
lines.zh: : 那差不多就是……我今天想谈的大事。

lines.en: : I just figured that...we wouldn’t really be able to talk about {i}anything{/i} with the way things were between us and...it’s not like I {i}wanted{/i} things to be bad anymore.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得……以我们之间现在这个样子,我们根本{i}什么{/i}都谈不了,而且……我也并不{i}希望{/i}事情继续这么糟下去了。

lines.en: : You...wanted to talk about...
lines.zh: : 你……想谈的是……

lines.en: scene rinmolly24
: Wait...are you-
lines.zh: : 等等……你该不会——

lines.en: : I, Rin Rokuhara...
lines.zh: : 我,Rin Rokuhara……

lines.en: : Hereby formally resign from the manga club.
lines.zh: : 在此正式退出漫画部。

lines.en: scene rinmolly25
: But...what?!
: No! You can’t! You won’t! You love manga!
lines.zh: : 不!你不能!你不会的!你爱漫画!

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} love manga, yes.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}爱漫画,没错。

lines.en: : But there’s always been something else I’ve loved even more.
lines.zh: : 但一直都有另一样东西,是我爱得更深的。

lines.en: scene rinmolly26
: Damn it, Otoha! Just how much will you steal from me?!
lines.zh: : 该死,Otoha!你到底要从我这里抢走多少东西?!

lines.en: : I, uhh...I was talking about music...
lines.zh: : 我,呃……我说的是音乐……

lines.en: scene rinmolly27
: Are you really leaving?...Can’t you just...play music in your free time?
lines.zh: : 你真的要走吗?……你就不能……在空闲时间玩音乐吗?

lines.en: : I want to play as much as I can whenever I can. And as a fellow otaku, I know you’re the same way with your hobbies.
lines.zh: : 我想能弹多少就弹多少,什么时候能弹就什么时候弹。而作为同为御宅族的人,我知道你对自己的爱好也是一样的。

lines.en: : I’ve finally got an opportunity to play more...to see my girlfriend more...and to hang out with a new group of friends that all share my biggest love with me.
lines.zh: : 我终于得到了一个机会——能弹得更多……能多见我女朋友……还能跟一群跟我分享最大爱好的新朋友混在一起。

lines.en: : There was no way I was going to turn that down...
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能拒绝得了……

lines.en: : Plus...this might give you and me the space we need to kind of...get back to normal-ish...don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 再说……这也许能给你和我所需要的空间,好让我们……差不多回到正常……你不这么觉得吗?

lines.en: scene rinmolly28
: I don’t want you to leave...
lines.zh: : 我不想让你走……

lines.en: : I’m not “leaving.”
lines.zh: : 我没有「走」。

lines.en: : I’m just trying something new.
lines.zh: : 我只是去试试新的东西。

lines.en: : And hey, if I don’t fit in or I just suck or something, I might come running back.
lines.zh: : 而且嘿,要是我融入不了,或者我实在太烂什么的,我也许会哭着跑回来的。

lines.en: : But seeing as you’re the club president...and my {i}friend...{/i}I needed you to know that.
lines.zh: : 不过鉴于你是社团的部长……也是我的{i}朋友……{/i}我觉得你需要知道这件事。

lines.en: : But hey, with the whole club reassignment thing going on, I’m sure someone just as cool as me will fill my space in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,现在正赶上社团重新分配,我相信很快就会有跟我一样酷的人填上我的位置。

lines.en: scene rinmolly29
: Hah...I do hope so. Ami and I have been doing our best trying to recruit new members over the last several days, but even the Kendo Princess seems to be on the fence.
lines.zh: : 哈……我也希望如此。这几天 Ami 和我一直在尽力招新,可就连剑道公主似乎也还在犹豫。

lines.en: : Well, Tsuneyo is {i}way{/i} cooler than me, so maybe you should try aiming a little bit lower?
lines.zh: : 嗯,Tsuneyo 可比我{i}酷多了{/i},所以也许你该把目标放低一点?

lines.en: : Are you sure this is what you want, Nithhala?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定这是你想要的吗,Nithhala?

lines.en: : Are you really going to use my D&D name when it was that exact game that got us into this mess in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你真的要用我的 D&D 名字吗?明明就是那个游戏最先把我们弄进这团乱麻里的。

lines.en: scene rinmolly30
: It was never about that.
lines.zh: : 从来就不是因为那个。

lines.en: : That was just one more example of me trying to keep you from slipping away.
lines.zh: : 那只是我试图不让你溜走的又一个例子而已。

lines.en: : But I suppose you’ve slipped far enough by now that there’s no way I’ll ever pull you back.
lines.zh: : 不过我想,你已经溜得够远了,我再也没法把你拉回来了。

lines.en: scene rinmolly31
: You won’t have to pull me {i}at all{/i} for at least one night of every week since I think we’re ready to start the campaign back up now.
lines.zh: : 至少每周有一个晚上,你{i}完全{/i}不必拉我,因为我觉得我们现在可以重新开始那场战役了。

lines.en: : But every other night, your girl’s gonna be workin’ on becoming a rock star.
lines.zh: : 不过其他每个晚上,你的姑娘都要忙着成为摇滚明星了。

lines.en: : You’ll always be a rock star to me, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你对我来说永远都是摇滚明星,Rin。

lines.en: scene rinmolly32
: Dude, cringe. You sounded like my mom just now.
lines.zh: : 老兄,好尬。你刚刚听起来跟我妈一样。

lines.en: : I mean it, though. I’ll always admire you. It doesn’t make much of a difference if it’s from up close or afar.
lines.zh: : 不过我是认真的。我会一直仰慕你。是从近处还是远处,并没有多大区别。

lines.en: : Just stay within sixty feet and I’ll always be able to reach you in one turn.
lines.zh: : 只要待在六十英尺以内,我一回合总能够到你。

lines.en: : Uhh...sixty feet seems a little close, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 呃……六十英尺好像有点近了吧,你不觉得吗?

lines.en: : Enjoy your new club, Rin...
lines.zh: : 好好享受你的新社团吧,Rin……

lines.en: : I hope it will be one you don’t slip away from.
lines.zh: : 我希望那是一个你不会再从中溜走的社团。

lines.en: scene rinmolly33
: Here’s hoping it won’t be, I guess.
lines.zh: : 但愿不会吧,我想。

lines.en: : Aye. Here’s hoping it won’t.
lines.zh: : 嗯。但愿不会。

lines.en: : Still homies?
lines.zh: : 还是好哥们?

lines.en: : Still homies.
lines.zh: : 还是好哥们。

lines.en: scene rinmolly34
: Also, have I mentioned how much I love your new uniform yet? Or did the ever growing distance between us prevent my words from reaching you?
lines.zh: : 还有,我提过我多喜欢你的新校服了吗?还是说我们之间越来越远的距离,让我的话传不到你那里了?

lines.en: : You’re free to admire it all you want. Just don’t try to tackle me this time.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么看都随你。只是这次别再扑倒我就行。

lines.en: scene rinmolly35
: Kidding! Now, let’s head back inside and sign away our respective destinies to yet another year’s worth of club activities and friendships.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的!好了,我们回里面去吧,把各自的命运签给又一年的社团活动和友情。

lines.en: : Aye. I hope I don’t accidentally trip and land on top of you along the way...
lines.zh: : 好啊。希望我路上不会不小心绊倒,正好摔在你身上……

lines.en: scene black
Somehow or another, the sun slipped away.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的,太阳溜走了。

lines.en: The gaze of a god disappeared along with it.
lines.zh: 神的目光也随之消失了。

lines.en: Somehow or another, things turned out okay.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的,事情有了个还不错的收场。

lines.en: And two girls poised to burn somehow remained hidden.
lines.zh: 而那两个蓄势待燃的女孩,不知怎么地仍藏得好好的。
